# --plan, --dump, --info and --graph describe the build without running it,
# and --dump shows a secret as its call, never its value.
env API_TOKEN=s3cr3t-value
bit --plan
stdout '^lib \+ printf lib > lib.txt'
# An output not yet produced shows as its reference.
stdout '^app \+ cat #\{lib\.path\} > app.txt'
! exists lib.txt

bit --info
stdout 'region \(string = "eu"\)'
stdout 'default — Build the app\.'
stdout '^Outputs:'
stdout 'result'

bit --graph app
stdout 'lib──.*app'

bit
stdout 'app ✔'
grep '\Alib\z' app.txt

bit --plan
stdout '^lib · '
stdout '^app · '

bit --dump token
stdout 'TOKEN: secret\("API_TOKEN"\)'
! stdout 's3cr3t'
grep '\As3cr3t-value\z' token.txt

bit --dump app
stdout 'command: cat lib.txt > app.txt'
stdout 'path: app.txt'

# --clean destroys in reverse order, and a second clean has nothing to do.
bit --clean
stdout 'app ▶ rm app.txt'
stdout 'lib ▶ rm lib.txt'
! exists app.txt lib.txt
bit --clean
stdout 'app · no state'
stdout 'lib · no state'

-- BUILD.bit --
param region = "eu"

lib = exec {
  command = "printf lib > lib.txt"
  outputs = "lib.txt"
}

app = exec {
  command = "cat #{lib.path} > app.txt"
  outputs = "app.txt"
}

token = exec {
  env = { TOKEN = secret("API_TOKEN"), REGION = region }
  command = "printf %s \"$TOKEN\" > token.txt"
  outputs = "token.txt"
}

# Build the app.
group default = [app, token]

output result = app.path
